infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Incline checks once, at the moment you start a session, to see whether you're at a verified study spot. It never tracks you in the background.
infoPlist.//: The dev backend is plain http on a LAN address. Expo Go already permits this; the exception only matters if this is ever built as a standalone app.

extra.//: Point this at the machine running `pnpm dev` in the repo root. Read at runtime via expo-constants, so changing it is a reload, not a rebuild.
